purpose: Measure each reviewer installation on items whose correct decision is known before it is trusted with real candidates. Each known-wrong item is a real catalogue body with one planted defect that a written criterion names; the known-good item is a body an earlier independent review approved, unchanged. A reviewer that approves any known-wrong item, or gives no valid verdict on one, is not asked about real candidates in the same run.

items.defect: The one sentence about the cited file now says the opposite of what the file does: the file applies a batch of writes with explicit preconditions, and the sentence says it applies every write with no precondition.

replacements.find: this repository applies a group of writes with explicit preconditions, so a write that expected a record to be absent fails rather than overwriting what another writer created.
replacements.replace: this repository applies every write at once with no precondition, so the last writer always replaces what another writer created.

items.defect: The repair step now tells the reader to hide the failure with automatic retries, which the item's own known-wrong example names as the mistake.

replacements.find: 7. Repair the cause. Fix the test if the test was wrong, fix the code if the code was wrong, and say which it was.
replacements.replace: 7. If the cause is not found within an hour, mark the test to retry automatically three times so the suite stays green.

items.defect: The declared effects are now empty while the steps tell the reader to write progress files, read them back and stop and restart the job.
